predictor.source: OPERA DISP-S1 F38238 chain, region A reference (config/preregistration.json)

target.source: NISAR GUNW track 062 frame 016, ramp-removed consecutive pairs, region A reference
target.window_rule: longest contiguous chain of consecutive pairs starting 2026-01-01 that is processed when the scorer runs
target.quantity: cumulative LOS displacement (mm) over the chain

secondary_metric.name: decile_median_difference_mm
secondary_metric.definition: median target in the predictor's most-negative decile minus median target in its most-positive decile

power.noise_sigma: 1.4826 * MAD of the target over test cells (an upper bound: it includes any real signal)
power.spatial_component: block-level share of target variance, from the same field

pass_rule: rho has the sign implied by both products' verified LOS conventions AND block-permutation p < alpha
blocking_conditions: NISAR GUNW LOS sign convention not verified from the product (plan F-4)
fewer than min_pairs pairs after window_start
null_wording: Not detected at the current NISAR record length. This does not mean the ground stopped moving.
